tools.name: find
tools.description: Works out whether a string is a Dogecoin block height, block hash, transaction id or address, and which tool to call next. Use it when unsure.

query.description: A block height, block hash, transaction id or address.

tools.name: get_address
tools.description: A Dogecoin address: balance (with its dollar value), totals received and sent, transaction count, its mining-pool name if any, rank among the largest holders, lookalike warnings, and its history newest first, 10 a page.

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: A Dogecoin block: when it was found, who mined it (pool name and payout address), reward and fees, size, confirmations, and its transactions as one-line stories, 25 a page.

block.description: A height, a 64-hex block hash, or "latest".

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: A Dogecoin chart series over time, oldest first: e.g. tx_count, fees_median, hashrate, difficulty, supply, price_usd, block_interval, active_addresses, pool_share, holder_share.

interval.description: Default day. minute is for tx_per_min only; pool_share, transfers and holder_share come by day or hour.

last.description: How many of the latest points (default 30).

tools.name: get_fees
tools.description: What it costs to send DOGE right now: the least a payment can pay, what people actually paid lately, next-block fee rates and how many transactions are waiting.

tools.name: get_network
tools.description: The Dogecoin network now: the newest block, the mempool and next-block fees, hashrate, difficulty, the latest blocks and the biggest recent transfers.

tools.name: get_rich_list
tools.description: The 1,000 addresses holding the most DOGE, 100 a page, with how concentrated holdings are. Big holders are often exchanges.

tools.name: get_supply
tools.description: How many DOGE exist, how many are added each day and year (10,000 per block, no maximum), and inflation now and ahead.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: A Dogecoin transaction in plain English: who paid whom, how much, the likely change, the fee, its confirmations, every input and output, and any address-poisoning (lookalike) warning.
